cited_by.title: Hair breakage, growth and keeping length

record.population: 38 adults from Central and West Africa
record.finding: Mean growth 256 micrometres a day against 396 in Caucasian volunteers (comparison from earlier work); density 190 against 227 hairs per cm squared. By my arithmetic that is about 0.8 cm a month against 1.2.
record.note: Author affiliation L'Oreal. Small sample; comparison with older data. Growth rate is not length kept.
